text.description_html:
Omnia Elegance 5" Ring Door Knocker.

Omnia's door knockers add those details, those distinctive touches which claify and reinforce fine architecture and design. Their dedication to detail is revealed in the latest selection of solid brass door knockers.

After hand poishing and high buffing, a hard and transparent lacquer is baked onto each piece. This special process retains the tradition of old world excellence while employing the best available modern technology to protect and preserve your fine taste.

The Omnia Max-Brass finish will change the way you think about finishes. The unique process in the manufacturing provides a superior resistance to tarnish or pitting. Max Brass is a PVD polished brass coating that is highly resistant to extreme elements. It has a lifetime No Tarnish Guarantee. Recommended for harsh environments such as salty air.

Specifications for Omnia 698/100 Ring Door Knocker

  • Overall Size: 5"
  • Center to Center Mounting Holes: 3-3/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Material: Solid Brass

*Sold Individually
